title: Supported tower diagonal data and finite Tate-line pullback
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $S$, using Chern data [def-sp-tower-class-chern], $P=\mathbf P^1_S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] and $W=P\times_SP$ with diagonal $\Delta$ [det-prop-diagonal-tower-system]. Define the diagonal line as the dual of its ideal [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle], with its invertibility, and the hyperplane Picard class as the actual projective twist $\mathcal O_P(1)$ [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. The integral diagonal boundary is the negative of the recorded positive roof, followed by the canonical units comparison and the exact constant-tower functor. Reduce and extend it using the same Chern data to obtain the supported arrow. Define diagonal data to consist of the recorded tower geometry [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], coefficient pullback fixed on all finite sections, and its supported-source comparison fixed by the integral quotient unit; require the composite after forgetting support to equal $c_1(\mathcal O_W(\Delta))$. Define the finite Tate-line realization by the unique isomorphism taking every scalar multiple of a root generator to the identical tensor. These are specified objects and arrows, not arbitrary supported classes.
